EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other conditions as per tender documents annexed
University reserves the right to accept or reject all or any tenders without assigning any reasons thereto
GST as applicable shall be paid on quoted rates
